auditScope: Read-only retained native traces/drivers plus non-model executions of the original delivered CLI and deliberately broken control. No task/message/model/service resubmission.
negativeControl: Program ignores both CSV and date; prints hardcoded known outputs and switches only on presence of --product.
interpretation: Old artifact oracle has demonstrated false-positive capability. This does not establish that the actual delivered CLI was fake: its retained bytes passed all5new cases.
architectureTestWeaknesses: Explicit correction and explicit unrelated/no-action wording make semantic relevance selection easy.
Status question repeats the correction topic and cues attention.
Two tasks are one short session/one agent with3contexts, not independent repeated trials or cross-agent evidence.
Writer active flag establishes an admitted inference at the observed time, not a command in flight or that a stale implementation was already committed.
Second test was a clean reader stop while idle. Same native thread IDs establish identity, not arbitrary crash or compaction recovery.
Fields semanticOwnerInterventions=0 and codeChangedDuringSuccessfulSemanticRuns=false were recorded assertions, not independently enforced measurements.
No pre-registered baseline/ablation comparison demonstrates superiority over the prior reader architecture.
No automated gate currently prevents promoting this smoke evidence into a broader readiness claim.
supportedClaims: Real native model contexts produced attributable tool calls and canonical events.
Exact incoming fragments were retained in native reader history without model-selected primary reads in the first run.
Specific same-work correction, status answer and delivered output occurred in one connected smoke journey.
A clean idle-reader restart retained and later handled two specific messages.
Retained delivered artifact is general enough to pass5additional unseen valid-input cases.

nextEvaluationContract.freezeBeforeModels: Ordinary tasks, unlabeled mixed room traffic, expected outcome and operational limits; generated inputs held outside agent workspace.
nextEvaluationContract.failOn: Dropped necessary information, invented completion, changed objective, wrong audience, unnecessary assignment/reply cycle, unfinished deliverable or human semantic rescue.
nextEvaluationContract.negativeControls: Require scorer to reject ignored-message, irrelevant-work, fixed-output and false-completion controls before interpreting a live pass.
nextEvaluationContract.sample: Predeclare a finite varied set; keep every failure and count interventions. Compare a baseline/ablation when claiming a causal advantage.
nextEvaluationContract.focus: One actual collaborative deliverable including a non-prescriptive discovery while writer is already executing; compaction/reconnect are explicit separate conditions.
